implementation_statement: The BIA (P05), POL-01 section 11, and the P08 runbook form the contingency plan. Gaps: the successor manager has no access sheet or recovery codes, and no one but the owner can release a payment (due 2026-12-31).

evidence: Account security pages; P07 sign-in tests
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); CSF 2.0 portfolio profile PR.AA-03 (voluntary)

Password manager by 2026-09-15.

implementation_statement: Paper move-in forms are cross-cut shredded at the Storage office. Gaps: no rule for deleting rental applications, screening reports, and driver license scans when no longer needed, and no procedure for wiping old devices.
First risk assessment completed 2026-07-31 using SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (P01), covering all four entities. Reviewed each July and after a major change such as buying or selling an LLC.

The IT technician signed a confidentiality and security agreement on 2026-07-24, and the accounting service's SOC 2 report was reviewed on 2026-07-29. Gaps: no vendor list; the bookkeeper has no written confidentiality or security terms; no other vendor's terms or assurance have been read.
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2), (6); CSF 2.0 portfolio profile GV.SC-05 (voluntary)

implementation_statement: Host firewalls are on and the home office and Storage office routers block inbound connections. Gap: at the laundromat, customer Wi-Fi is on the same network as the POS tablet and payment hub. Separate guest network by 2026-10-31.

All SaaS, banking, and payment traffic uses TLS (inherited). Card data is encrypted by the processors' hosted fields and readers. The owner sends rental documents only through the property management platform or encrypted suite links.
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); CSF 2.0 portfolio profile PR.DS-02 (voluntary)

implementation_statement: Vendors encrypt stored data; the owner's laptop has full-disk encryption and the phone is encrypted by its passcode. Gap: the Storage office desktop has no disk encryption and no sign-in password (fixed by 2026-09-15).
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); CSF 2.0 portfolio profile PR.DS-01 (voluntary)

implementation_statement: Vendors patch their platforms; automatic updates are on for the laptop, phone, Storage desktop, and POS tablet. Gap: router firmware and the gate controller have never been updated. The IT technician checks both each July.
Built-in antivirus with real-time scanning and automatic updates runs on the laptop and the Storage desktop. Owner responsibility: keep it on and act on alerts.
